feeds.title: MakeKit DIY Craft Kits Blog
feeds.description: Read MakeKit DIY Craft Kits Blog to learn about how to harness your creativity, photography tips, and awesome craft projects with fabric scraps or felt balls. Are you looking to reclaim a childhood hobby or simply looking for some time out to recharge and relax? MakeKit boxes are modern craft kits for adults and kids. Each beautiful kit comes with everything you need.

feeds.title: Squoodles NZ Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Squoodles: NZ's favorite online wooden toy shop! Owned by husband and wife team Dean and Tracy Morgan, they created Squoodles with you in mind. The Squoodles blog shares fun and educational activities for kids. From art and crafts to science experiments, this blog is a helpful place for parents, teachers, and caregivers.

feeds.title: Modern Teaching Aids NZ Blog » Art & Craft
feeds.description: Modern Teaching Blog NZ has a category for Art and crafts that provide helpful articles for its readers. The topics for the blog are crafts for Christmas, activities for the spooky season, Christmas In The Classroom, Spark The Christmas Imagination, and more. The Modern Teaching Blog is a bustling hub of ideas, inspiration, and support for your classroom and beyond.

feeds.title: Lincraft New Zealand Blog
feeds.description: In 2016, Lincraft launched its Lincraft Essentials store model. Lincraft Essentials are more intimate, specialized, and compact stores that are focused on craft, fabric, patterns, wool, and haberdashery products. Follow Lincraft's blog to get helpful articles on Back-to-School Essentials, 9 Home Essentials, Home Refresher, Beginner's Guide to Quilting and more.

feeds.title: Clever Poppy Blog
feeds.description: Clever Poppy Blog publishes articles on DIY Photo Advent Calendar, DIY Christmas Advent Village, Surprise Photo Box, Easy DIY Tie-Dyed Tee, and many other helpful informative articles. Clever Poppy is a creative website that provides you with DIY arts, crafts, gift ideas, activities with kids, and the latest trends.

feeds.title: Eco Art And Craft Blog
feeds.description: The company's multi-award-winning products are designed and handmade in Australia with a focus on sustainability and open-ended creativity. The products they offer are eco crayons, eco arts and crafts kits, natural eco paints, sensory plays, and more. Their Eco Art And Craft Blog features articles on crayons, the environment, natural products, non-toxic paints, toddlers' products, and more.

feeds.title: Hobby Land Blog
feeds.description: Learn new art and craft tips and tricks on the Hobby Land Blog also Discover how-to articles, and art product highlights and get inspired by their community. Hobby Land is your new destination to shop art and craft supplies, office and school stationery, and everything in-between at low prices, every day. 100% New Zealand-owned and operated, Hobby Land delivers thousands of products from leading local and international brands, right at your doorstep.

feeds.title: The ReCreators Blog
feeds.description: The ReCreators is a Social Enterprise based in Auckland, New Zealand, which promotes upcycling by learning to do it yourself (DIY) through our community workshops, purchasing pre-made products, or collaborating on a custom circular design. The ReCreators Blog publishes articles on how to make a DIY Canvas Bag, How to Weave a Bee, How to make a Woven Llama, and more similar topics.

feeds.title: Oh Craft Blog
feeds.description: Oh Craft Blog is the place to get all the latest news and tips and tricks from the team at Oh Craft. They also cover the best gift ideas for most occasions, crafting tips, laser engraving and cutting techniques, and much more. Oh Craft is a creative studio specializing in handcrafted and laser-cut gifts, and home and party decorations. From small custom keychains to intricate wall art, our goal is to become New Zealand's top destination for unique handcrafted gifts and home decor.

feeds.title: Jenny Coyle Blog
feeds.description: Jenny Coyle's blog is an online scrapbook of her craft projects. In her blog, she shares information about her craft projects and provides step-by-step processes along with some DIYs. Her blog features year reviews, Christmas bassinet quilts, tapestries, Christmas stockings and similar projects.

feeds.title: Mollies DIY Blog
feeds.description: Mollies Make & Create is a family-run business with a passion for DIY crafts such as upholstery, leather craft, and furniture upcycling. Their blog features interesting topic such as Polymer Clay Baking Tips, Tools for removing staples, Make a pin-cushion from scraps, Painting floor stencils, 10 tips to reduce brush marks and similar topics.

feeds.title: Tiny Happy
feeds.description: Tiny Happy is a personal, creative, DIY, and art-based blog. The space is managed by Melissa, who on her blog posts content on rose or lemon lip balm, quick energy balls, avocado dyeing, recycled t-shirt skirts, shoulder bag tutorial and more.

feeds.title: Ashford NZ Blog
feeds.description: Based in Ashburton, New Zealand, Ashford Handicrafts are the world's leading manufacturer of Spinning Wheel, Weaving Looms, and other textile equipment and supplies. The Handicrafts blog shares information about the company's activities, Spinning Wheel Maintenance, Spinning Vertical Colour, Ashford Artist of the Month and more.
